description_en: Installs an application on a cloud phone
kebab_example: aliyun cloudphone install-application --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --oss-bucket phoneapplication --oss-object test.apk --region cn-hangzhou
name: InstallApplication

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the instance on which to execute the command. Valid values of N: 1 to 10
parameters.help_zh: 待执行命令的实例ID。N的范围：1~10
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The OSS bucket where the application file is stored.

Before importing an application file to the OSS bucket for the first time, add a RAM authorization policy. Otherwise, the NoSetRoletoECSServiceAcount error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
应用文件所在的OSS Bucket。

首次导入应用文件到该OSSBucket前，请添加RAM授权策略，否则会报错NoSetRoletoECSServiceAcount
parameters.name: oss_bucket

parameters.help_en: The name (key) of the OSS object where the application file is stored
parameters.help_zh: 应用文件所在的OSS Object的文件名称（key）
parameters.name: oss_object
